timebase: Video-relative fixed30Hz replay control-step time; all cameras and signals captured after the same physics/control step.
sample_hz_note: Every third recorded observation, plus exact final sample; no signal interpolation or smoothing. Use time_seconds to index samples.
force_kind: Nonnegative normal contact force per recorded taxel channel
display_note: Recorded channel-index heatmap. No anatomical/spatial positions were inferred.

proprioception.pose_frame: Simulator world frame, recorded TCP pose

instruction: Grasp the radial tab on top of the fixed kettle lid and rotate it until the end of the tab is aligned with the target notch on the kettle opening.
